Mini-golf concept

Wonderball

An 18 hole mini golf concept for an exciting new venue in the USA, The Park @ RVA. Based around a day in the park we created an immersive and exciting experience. A Smith & Devil project.

The work

Our Invention

A Surreal Day At The Park

The design concept behind The Park RVA is the bring the outdoors - inside. Our goal was to amplify that experience with a premium, visual centrepiece that turns fun-seeking customers into social media advocates.

Our solution was to create an abstract celebration of fun in the park, in the form of a public art installation. Step into the outrageously fun heart & soul of the Park RVA. All the best things about the ultimate trip to the park expressed through the language of public art. Two 9 hole courses, with a surreal twist on everyday items, and an imaginative take on the fun of the fair.
